fullDescription: A warm cream-paper SaaS pricing page with a terracotta accent, Fraunces serif display type, and three reflowing tiers anchored by a lifted 'Most popular' middle card.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, editorial light-mode SaaS pricing page in cream/paper tones with a terracotta accent and a Fraunces serif display face. Three tiers (Starter / Pro / Team) on reflowing cards, the middle Pro card lifted and outlined as 'Most popular', plus a monthly/yearly billing toggle with a 'Save 20%' chip and a details/summary FAQ accordion. The transferable value is this exact cozy-stationery aesthetic paired with a conventional 3-tier-with-popular-middle pricing structure.

## Estilo Visual
Use a light, warm editorial palette on a textured paper background. Exact colors: page/paper background #f7f4ee, card surface #fffdf8, primary text 'ink-900' #16140f, secondary text 'ink-700' #403a30, muted text 'ink-500' #6b6354, faint text 'ink-400' #8a8174. Single terracotta accent #e0542c, with accent-soft tint #fbe9e1 and a darker accent-ink #b53e1c for accent text/links; a calm mint #0f6b53 for checkmarks, positive trust cues, and the 'Save 20%' chip. Typography: Fraunces (serif, optical-sizing, weights 400-700) as the display face for the logo wordmark, section headlines, plan names, and prices; Inter (weights 400-700) for all body copy, nav, feature lists, and buttons. Prices use tabular-nums. Rounded corners (cards rounded-2xl ~16px, buttons rounded-xl ~12px, pills/chips fully rounded). Soft layered shadows: a subtle card shadow (0 1px 2px + 0 12px 28px -16px of warm ink) and a stronger terracotta-tinted 'pop' shadow for the highlighted card. Add a very faint dotted grain overlay (radial-gradient dots, ~2.5% opacity, 4px tile) over the hero. Backdrop-blurred translucent paper nav. Antialiased text, generous whitespace, calm and premium, never neon or corporate-blue.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0, high z-index) with a translucent paper background (bg-paper at ~85% opacity) and backdrop-blur, plus a hairline bottom shadow. Inside a max-w-6xl centered row with px-6 py-4: left side has the brand lockup (a small ~32px rounded-lg ink-900 square holding a sparkle icon in paper color, next to the 'Promptbook' wordmark in Fraunces 600) followed by horizontal nav links (Library, Templates, Pricing [current, ink-900 medium], Docs) hidden on mobile. Right side: a 'Sign in' text link (hidden on small) and a solid ink-900 'Start free' button with paper-colored text and rounded-lg corners that darkens to black on hover.

### Hero / headline
A centered hero (max-w-2xl) at the top of the pricing section. Start with a small rounded-full pill badge: accent-soft background, thin accent border, accent-ink text, a small cards icon, reading '7,400+ designer-crafted prompts'. Below it a large two-line Fraunces serif headline (~44px mobile up to ~58px desktop, weight 600, tight tracking, leading ~1.04): 'Pricing that scales with your craft'. Then a muted ink-500 subhead (~16-17px, max-w-xl): 'Start free, ship faster. Every plan unlocks the prompt library, the canvas, and one-click handoff to your coding agent.' Place this over the faint grain overlay.

### Trust row + billing toggle
Below the hero, a flex row that stacks on mobile and splits left/right on desktop. Left: a wrapping set of trust items in muted ink-500 (~13.5px), each a mint check-circle icon + label: 'No card to start', 'Cancel anytime', 'Free migrations'. Right: the billing switcher: the word 'Monthly', a custom pill toggle switch (46x26px track, 20px white knob, default track #d9d2c4, turns terracotta #e0542c when checked, knob slides right), the word 'Yearly', and a mint-tinted rounded-full chip 'Save 20%'. Toggling switches all per-plan prices and billing sublines between monthly and yearly values.

### Pricing cards (the core)
A responsive pricing grid (grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3, items-start, ~20px gap) of three plan cards. Each card: rounded-2xl, card background, thin warm-ink border, soft card shadow, ~28px padding, flex-col. Card anatomy top to bottom: plan name in Fraunces ~22px 600; a one-line muted descriptor; a big price block (Fraunces ~46px 600, tabular-nums) with a '/mo' suffix in faint ink-400; a small billing subline; a full-width CTA button; a tiny reassurance line ('No card required. Cancel anytime.' / 'Upgrade anytime.'); then a top-bordered feature section led by an uppercase tracked label ('What's included' / 'Everything in Starter, plus' / 'Everything in Pro, plus') and a list of features each prefixed by a small check icon. TIER 1 'Starter': $0/mo, 'Free forever, no card needed.', outline/ghost button ('Start for free') on paper background, mint checks; features: 30 prompts/month, 1 active canvas, Community prompt library, PNG export. TIER 2 'Pro' (HIGHLIGHTED, middle): a 2px terracotta border, a top-to-bottom gradient from accent-soft (~60%) down to card color, the stronger terracotta 'pop' shadow, and on large screens lifted upward (negative top margin ~ -24px) so it rises above its neighbors; an absolutely-positioned 'Most popular' badge top-right (solid terracotta pill, white text, star icon); price $24/mo monthly or $19/mo yearly rendered in accent-ink with subline 'Billed monthly.' / '$228 billed yearly, save $60.'; a solid terracotta primary CTA 'Start 14-day trial' with white text; accent-colored checks; features: Unlimited prompts & canvases, Full 7,400+ prompt library, Coding-agent handoff (MCP), Component & React export, Version history. TIER 3 'Team': $59/mo monthly or $47/mo yearly, subline 'Per editor, billed monthly.' / 'Per editor, $564/yr, save $144.', outline/ghost button 'Start 14-day trial', mint checks; features: Shared team workspace, Brand kits & design tokens, Roles & permissions, Priority support, SSO & audit log. On medium (2-col) the Team card spans both columns and centers (max-w-md); on large it returns to a normal third column. Under the grid, a centered muted line: 'Need volume seats or an enterprise plan? Talk to us.' with the link in accent-ink.

### FAQ accordion
A FAQ section on the card-colored background, separated by a top hairline border. Centered Fraunces heading (~30-36px 600) 'Questions, answered' with a muted ink-500 subhead 'Everything you need to know before you start.' Below, a max-w-3xl list of native details/summary accordion rows separated by hairline dividers (divide + top/bottom border). Each summary row: a ~16px medium ink-900 question on the left and a plus icon on the right that rotates 45deg (into an x) when open; the answer is muted ink-500 ~14.5px with relaxed leading. First item open by default. Questions: 'Can I switch plans later?', 'What happens when my trial ends?', 'Do prompts work with my coding agent?', 'Is there a discount for annual billing?'.

### Footer
A minimal footer on the paper background. A max-w-6xl row that stacks on mobile and spreads on desktop: left the brand lockup again (small ink-900 rounded square with sparkle icon + 'Promptbook' in Fraunces), center a wrapping row of muted text links (Library, Changelog, Privacy, Terms) that darken on hover, right a faint copyright line 'c 2026 Promptbook'.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Highlighted 'Most popular' middle card — The Pro tier is the focal point: outlined in 2px terracotta, filled with a soft accent gradient, given a terracotta-tinted drop shadow, lifted above its neighbors on desktop via a negative top margin, and tagged with an absolutely-positioned solid-terracotta 'Most popular' star pill in the top-right corner.
Make the center pricing card the visual hero: border-2 in accent #e0542c, a background gradient from accent-soft (~60% opacity) at top to card color at bottom, a stronger terracotta-tinted shadow (e.g. 0 28px 60px -24px rgba(224,84,44,.32)), and on large screens shift it up with a negative top margin (~ -24px) so it overlaps the baseline of the other two cards. Pin a 'Most popular' badge in the top-right: a solid accent rounded-full pill with white 600 text and a small star icon. Use accent-ink for its price and accent-colored checkmarks so the whole card reads as the recommended choice.

### Monthly / Yearly billing toggle — A custom pill switch flanked by 'Monthly' and 'Yearly' labels and a mint 'Save 20%' chip; flipping it swaps every plan's price and billing subline between monthly and yearly figures (Pro $24->$19, Team $59->$47, etc.).
Build a custom toggle switch: a 46x26px rounded-full track (default #d9d2c4) with a 20px white knob and soft shadow; when checked the track fills terracotta #e0542c and the knob slides right ~20px. Add a visible focus ring on keyboard focus. Flank it with 'Monthly' (left, ink-700) and 'Yearly' (right, ink-900) labels plus a mint-tinted rounded-full 'Save 20%' chip. Wire it so toggling adds a class on the page root that hides the monthly price/subline spans and shows the yearly ones across all plan cards (Pro shows $19 and '$228 billed yearly, save $60'; Team shows $47 and 'Per editor, $564/yr, save $144').

### Grain texture overlay — A barely-there dotted paper grain layered over the hero/pricing section that sells the warm, hand-made stationery feel.
Overlay a pointer-events-none absolute layer across the hero/pricing section using a radial-gradient of tiny warm-ink dots (rgba(22,20,15,.025) 1px dots on a 4px x 4px tile) to give the cream background a subtle paper grain. Keep it under the content (low/zero opacity look) so text stays crisp.

### Feature lists with iconography — Each tier lists its features under an uppercase section label, with small check icons color-keyed per tier (mint on Starter/Team, terracotta on Pro).
Under a hairline top divider in each card, add an uppercase, letter-spaced, ~12.5px label ('What's included' / 'Everything in Starter, plus' / 'Everything in Pro, plus') in muted (or accent-ink on the Pro card) followed by a vertically-spaced list. Each list item: a small check-bold icon (mint #0f6b53 on Starter and Team, accent #e0542c on Pro) aligned to the top of an ink-700 ~14px label.

## Notas Especiais
This is a frameless, fully responsive web page, not a fixed artboard. Content is centered in a max-w-6xl (~1152px) column with px-6 gutters. The nav is sticky with a translucent backdrop-blurred paper background. The pricing grid reflows 3 -> 2 -> 1 columns; on the 2-column breakpoint the third 'Team' card centers under the first two, and the Pro card's desktop upward lift only applies at the 3-column (lg) size. Headlines, plan names and prices use the Fraunces serif; everything else uses Inter. Prices use tabular-nums so the monthly/yearly swap doesn't shift layout. Keep the single-terracotta-accent discipline: terracotta is reserved for the highlighted Pro card, primary CTAs, links and the toggle's on-state; mint is only for positive/trust cues. Built with Tailwind (CDN config defines the custom ink/paper/accent/mint palette and the card/pop/nav shadows) and Iconify (Phosphor 'ph:' icon set).
